_description: Reusable emitter archetypes for bootstrapping Niagara authoring. The AI should map recipe layers onto one of these starting patterns before editing stack details.

sprite_fountain_loop.description: Looping sprite emitter with upward motion. Good base for fire cores, smoke plumes, ambient magical wisps, and fountain-like continuous motion.

sprite_burst.description: Burst-oriented sprite emitter for one-shot impacts, dust pops, flashes, and short-lived energy hits.

smoke_billow.description: Soft sprite emitter emphasizing drag, curl noise, growth over life, and translucent volume. Good base for smoke, fog, steam, and wisps.

spark_burst.description: Fast, lightweight accent emitter for embers, sparks, small debris, and energetic highlights.
spark_burst.authoring_intent: Use this as the default support-emitter pattern for short-lived spark, ember, and magic particle sprays. Prioritize burst readability, compact spawn region, and cheap secondary motion over hero-level complexity.

notes: Velocity-aligned sprites are preferred before escalating to ribbons.
Keep the material simple and let Niagara drive spread, timing, and per-particle variation.

emitter_update_modules: Spawn Rate (optional low sustain after burst)
particle_update_modules: Scale Sprite Size by Speed (preferred for sparks)

default_tuning.burst_count: 8-30 for general sparks, 4-12 for embers, 12-40 for magical spray accents
default_tuning.spawn_rate_after_burst: 0-12/sec depending on whether a short residual tail is needed
default_tuning.particle_lifetime: 0.08-0.45s for sparks, 0.25-1.2s for embers, 0.2-0.8s for magic motes
default_tuning.initial_size: 1-6 cm for sparks, 2-8 cm for embers, 2-10 cm for magic particles
default_tuning.cone_angle: wide for radial spray, narrow for directional release
default_tuning.gravity: 0 to -250 for stylized/magic, -150 to -600 for physical sparks

spawn_shape_guidance: Prefer a small sphere or compact point-like origin.
Keep the spawn region tight and let velocity create the perceived spread.
Layering two small sphere-location passes is acceptable when one origin looks too uniform.

embers.motion: slower than sparks, more drag, warmer color fade, optional slight gravity
embers.look: read as hot fallout rather than impact metal sparks

sparks.motion: high initial speed, strong directional read, short lifetime, velocity-aligned streak feel
sparks.look: bright first frame, die quickly, keep local to event

magic_particles.motion: lower gravity, can keep a slight sustain after burst, color fade is more important than realism
magic_particles.look: can use softer masks and cleaner edge shaping than embers

reference_notes: A strong reference pattern is NE_spread_spark from the FlameThrowerBreath generic source.
This archetype is for secondary breakup and accent motion, not for hero silhouettes like flame bodies or plasma shells.

ribbon_trail.description: Trail-based emitter for slashes, electricity streaks, magical ribbons, and motion accents.

mesh_debris.description: Mesh-based emitter for rocks, chunks, leaves, and debris fragments.
